bezpieczenstwo.tytul: Your data never leaves your phone without your consent
bezpieczenstwo.lead: Safe Budget is built on the principle that your finances are nobody's business but yours. There is no server your data could end up on — and no one who could read it.

lista.opis: The app needs no internet connection and sends nothing — no accounts, no ads, no tracking and no usage statistics. Bank files are read only on your phone. Internet is needed only to buy the Pro version in the Google Play Store — without any budget data.

The budget stored on your phone is encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The data key is protected by your PIN (PBKDF2-SHA-256, 400,000 iterations), and the PIN itself is never stored anywhere. Without your PIN, fingerprint or face the data cannot be read — not even if the files are copied off the phone.

lista.tytul: Decrypted data stays in memory only.
lista.opis: The app decrypts the budget only after unlocking and keeps it in memory only — in the phone’s storage the budget is always encrypted.

A PIN (4 to 8 digits) is required every time the app starts, and the app locks itself after a period of inactivity (after 5 minutes by default — you can change this in Settings); time spent outside the app counts too. After 5 wrong attempts you have to wait 30 seconds, and twice as long after each further one (15 minutes at most).

When you turn this unlock on, the data key is kept in the phone’s secure key store (Android Keystore) and released only after your fingerprint or face is recognized — with face, there is no extra “Confirm” button. Face works on phones where Android treats face recognition as secure (as for payments); on other phones you open the app with your fingerprint or PIN. The PIN always remains available as a fallback.
Every change is first written to a temporary file and only then replaces the previous version — if the phone switches off while saving, your data is not damaged.

The automatic backup is encrypted and goes only to the folder you choose — the app can access that folder and nothing else. On another phone it opens only with the PIN that was set when the backup was saved. Excel and database-file copies saved manually are not encrypted — keep them somewhere safe.
The app does not use your contacts, location, camera or microphone. It can access files only when you pick them yourself (import, restoring a backup) or choose the folder for automatic backups.
Neither the app’s author nor anyone else knows it, so no one but you can read your data. If you forget your PIN, the only way out is to clear the app’s data — so make backups regularly.

lista.pytanie: Does the app need an account or the internet?
lista.odpowiedz: No. Safe Budget works fully offline and has no accounts at all. Your data never reaches the author's server.

lista.pytanie: Which banks can I import statements from?
lista.odpowiedz: The app reads statements as CSV, Excel (XLSX) and PDF files. The import preview shows everything before saving, and transactions you have already imported are skipped.

lista.pytanie: What happens when I change phones?
lista.odpowiedz: Save a budzet_domowy.db backup or turn on the encrypted automatic backup to a folder of your choice (e.g. in Google Drive). On the new phone you restore it with a single button.

lista.pytanie: What if I forget my PIN?
lista.odpowiedz: The PIN cannot be recovered — nobody but you knows it. That is why it is worth making regular backups.

lista.pytanie: How much does the app cost?
lista.odpowiedz: For the first {n} days all features are free. After that the basic features stay free, and the Pro version is a one-time purchase — no subscription and no ads.

sekcje.tytul: 1. Who is responsible for the app

sekcje.tresc: None. Safe Budget has no user accounts, no server and no analytics or advertising modules. Everything you enter or import (transactions, plan, categories, rules, settings) is stored only on your phone. The author of the app has no access to this data.

sekcje.tytul: 3. How your data is protected on the phone

sekcje.tresc: Only when you do it yourself: by sharing a backup file (e.g. by e-mail or to the cloud) or by choosing a folder for the automatic backup (e.g. in Google Drive). The automatic backup is encrypted; Excel and database-file backups saved manually are not — keep them in a safe place.

The purchase of the Pro version is handled by the Google Play Store in accordance with the Google Privacy Policy. The app does not share any budget data in the process, and the author does not receive any payment details.

The app does not use your contacts, location, camera or microphone. Your fingerprint and face are recognised by the Android system — and only if you turn on fingerprint or face unlock. The app only learns whether recognition succeeded; the fingerprint or the image of your face never reaches it.
You can delete your data by uninstalling the app or clearing its data in your phone's settings. Since the author stores none of your data, there is nothing to delete on the author's side.
The app is not directed at children and does not collect data from any users.
